production.note: US model years. First: American Honda's 12 May 2017 release: "The all-new 2017 Honda Civic Si Coupe and Civic Si Sedan will go on sale at Honda dealerships beginning tomorrow". Last: American Honda's 2020 release covers the 2020 Civic Si Sedan and Si Coupe (honda-us-2020-si-launch), and American Honda's Civic Si timeline goes from the 2020 model to the all-new 2022 Civic Si with no 2021 model listed (honda-us-si-timeline).

body.note: Sold as the Civic Si Coupe and the Civic Si Sedan, same powertrain and rating. The 10th-generation Civic hatchback was not offered as an Si.

configuration.note: '1.5-liter, turbocharged and intercooled DOHC 4-cylinder engine with direct injection'; American Honda's 2020 release: 'in-line 4-cylinder engine' (honda-us-2020-si-launch)

fuel.note: Direct-injected gasoline engine; no hybrid or other fuel is mentioned

drivetrain.note: TFLcar: 'All Si models are front-wheel drive and are exclusively equipped with a short-throw 6-speed manual gearbox.' Honda's release lists 'a helical limited-slip differential' but does not use the words front-wheel drive.

transmission.note: 'short-throw, 6-speed manual transmission'; no automatic or CVT was offered on the Si

powerHp.note: 2017 model year, coupe and sedan. Quote: "Peak output of 205 horsepower arrives 1,300 rpm lower in the rev range (5,700 vs. 7,000 rpm)." American Honda's 2017 Civic Facts Guide: "205 horsepower @ 5700 rpm (SAE net)" (honda-us-2017-civic-facts-guide). Unchanged through 2020: the 2020 release describes a "205-horsepower, 1.5-liter, direct injected and turbocharged in-line 4-cylinder engine" (honda-us-2020-si-launch).

weightLb.note: Si Coupe (the coupe is the standard body for this record), 6-speed manual (the only transmission), 2017 model year. Quote: "The Si Coupe, at 2,889 pounds, is 113 pounds lighter than before." The Si Sedan is heavier: "Civic Si Sedan curb weight, at 2,906 pounds, is down 96 pounds from the previous model" (same release); American Honda's 2020 competitive sheet also gives the 2020 Si Sedan at 2,906 lb: "The Civic Si Sedan's curb weight (2,906 lbs) is lighter than that of any GTI trim" (honda-us-2020-si-vs-gti).
